introduction: Claim Oregon’s earned income credit through your state tax return. Special state rules also provide a route for some filers using an ITIN.
description: Claim Oregon’s earned income credit through your state tax return. Special state rules also provide a route for some filers using an ITIN.

sections.who: Federal EITC eligibility generally establishes the Oregon credit. Oregon also describes eligibility when lack of a work-valid Social Security number is the only federal barrier.
sections.get: The credit can increase a refund. Tax-year instructions determine the calculation and any part-year or nonresident proration.
sections.docs:
• Income and federal return records.
  • Qualifying-dependent details.
  • Tax identification and any Schedule OR-EIC-ITIN information.
sections.apply:
1. Choose tax-year instructions

    Read Revenue’s credit guidance.

  2. Calculate the appropriate credit

    Check the young-dependent rule, Oregon percentage and ITIN schedule if applicable.

  3. File the state return

    Keep calculation records and submit required schedules.
sections.after: Save return copies and ask Revenue or a tax preparer about a calculation or amended return.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Oregon EIC and ITIN provisions. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Oregon describes a state route when the lack of a work-valid SSN is the only federal EITC barrier.
